title: ReLU Function Lab
tagline: Construct a continuous function from fixed ReLU hinges, then test what deterministic gradient descent finds.
summary: A classroom lab that separates a fixed-knot piecewise-linear witness from an optimizer run. Compare target and approximation curves, move knots directly, inspect every signed ReLU contribution on a shared scale, and distinguish training MSE from dense-grid approximation error.
highlights: Move fixed interpolation knots and see how each signed ReLU hinge changes the constructed piecewise-linear function.
Train the same one-hidden-layer model from deterministic random weights while tracking training-sample MSE, dense-grid MSE, and maximum grid gap separately.
Draw a continuous custom target, set an epsilon band, and state precisely what the construction, numerical grid, and optimizer run do and do not establish.
